title: SoK: From Finding to Deployment: Systematizing the OS Kernel Bug Lifecycle
abstract: arXiv:2609.23218v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Automated kernel bug discovery has advanced rapidly. Continuous fuzzing and static analysis systems, such as syzbot, now expose Linux kernel bugs at a scale that downstream processes struggle to absorb. Yet a crash report is only the beginning. Before a bug is eliminated, it must be triaged, understood, patched, validated, reviewed, integrated, and often backported. These later stages remain far less automated, creating a persistent gap between bug discovery and patch deployment.   This SoK systematizes the Linux kernel bug lifecycle from discovery to deployment. We organize prior work and production systems into five stages: discovery, triage, patch generation, patch validation, and integration. We explain the resulting automation gradient through kernel-specific challenges such as concurrency, implicit invariants, cross-syscall state, hardware dependence, lack of fault isolation, and architecture/configuration multiplicity. translated_title: SoK：从发现到部署：操作系统内核漏洞生命周期的系统化研究
translated_abstract: 自动化内核漏洞发现技术发展迅速。持续模糊测试和静态分析系统（如 syzbot）如今以难以被下游流程消化的规模暴露 Linux 内核漏洞。然而，崩溃报告仅仅是个开始。在漏洞被彻底消除之前，它必须经过分类、理解、修补、验证、审查、集成，并且经常需要向后移植。这些后期阶段的自动化程度仍远低于发现阶段，导致漏洞发现与补丁部署之间存在持续的差距。本 SoK 对从发现到部署的 Linux 内核漏洞生命周期进行了系统化研究。我们将先前的工作和生产系统组织为五个阶段：发现、分类、补丁生成、补丁验证和集成。我们通过内核特有的挑战（如并发性、隐式不变量、跨系统调用状态、硬件依赖、缺乏故障隔离以及架构/配置多样性）来解释由此产生的自动化梯度差异。我们进一步……
tldr: 这篇论文系统化了从发现到部署的 Linux 内核漏洞生命周期，将其组织为发现、分类、补丁生成、补丁验证和集成五个阶段，并通过内核特有的技术挑战解释了漏洞发现高度自动化与补丁部署自动化不足之间的差距。
en_tdlr: This SoK systematizes the Linux kernel bug lifecycle from discovery to deployment into five stages—discovery, triage, patch generation, patch validation, and integration—explaining the persistent automation gap between rapid bug discovery and slower patch deployment through kernel-specific challenges such as concurrency, implicit invariants, and lack of fault isolation.
